finding.comment: The central logger receives the live VAULT_KEY value; log aggregation leaks the credential far beyond this host.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/vault-fetch.sh
+++ b/scripts/vault-fetch.sh
@@ -6,3 +6,4 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+logger -t ship "using key $VAULT_KEY for $VAULT_ADDR"
 vault kv get -field=cert "$VAULT_ADDR" > cert.pem
